jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Solutions - Google Cloud
jobs.description:
**ABOUT APPLY**

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI\-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.

**LOCATION:** *APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to* ***ET (Eastern Timezone)****.*

**THE ROLE:**  

As Director, Enterprise Solutions \- Google Cloud, you'll drive how Apply Digital shapes, sells, and delivers complex cloud and AI solutions on Google Cloud for enterprise clients. Reporting into the VP, Enterprise Solutions, you'll bridge technical architecture, business strategy, and go\-to\-market execution. You'll be a hands\-on architect and trusted technology advisor to client executives while driving co\-sell engagement with Google Cloud's partner engineering, product, and field sales teams. You'll also help build and grow Apply Digital's internal Google Cloud community of practitioners, helping enterprise organizations use Gemini, Vertex AI, BigQuery, and cloud\-native platforms to create meaningful business value and competitive advantage.



### **RESPONSIBILITIES**



Strategic Leadership \& Solution Architecture


* Shape and execute the technology vision for enterprise clients on Google Cloud, aligning AI, data, and modernization solutions with business objectives and transformation goals
* Lead and personally contribute to the design and architecture of complex, enterprise\-level solutions using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI, BigQuery, AlloyDB, GKE, and Cloud Run
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on architecture best practices, emerging technologies, and industry trends
* Design next\-generation agentic and generative AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, multi\-agent workflows, and Gemini Enterprise implementations
* Define architecture strategies that ensure scalability, security, resilience, and long\-term value, including composable and API\-first approaches where they fit

Client Relationship Management


* Act as a trusted technology advisor to client executives and senior stakeholders
* Build CFO\-ready TCO and ROI models comparing on\-premise, multi\-cloud, and Google Cloud unit economics
* Lead discovery sessions, architecture reviews, solution design workshops, and technical presentations to align stakeholders on solution vision and approach
* Proactively identify opportunities to deliver additional value and expand Apply Digital's footprint within accounts

Pre\-Sales Leadership \& Revenue Growth


* Own pre\-sales execution for assigned enterprise pursuits, including discovery, solution design, and proof\-of\-concept (PoC) engagements
* Partner with Apply Digital sellers and Google Cloud account teams to co\-sell solutions, carrying a personal pipeline generation and revenue influence goal
* Produce RFP responses, Statements of Work, and technical proposals with explicit assumptions, bounded scope, and risk frameworks that protect delivery margins
* Use modern AI tools to speed up documentation, proposal drafting, and estimation without sacrificing engineering rigor

Google Cloud Ecosystem \& GTM Alignment


* Build and maintain strong relationships with Google Cloud Partner Engineers, Product Managers, and Field Sales to maximize joint deal routing and co\-sell priority
* Contribute to and participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and joint account planning to align Apply Digital's offerings with Google Cloud's strategic priorities, such as Data, Generative AI, and Modernization
* Represent Apply Digital at Google Cloud Next, industry events, webinars, and partner panels

Solution Productization \& Practice IP


* Identify high\-value patterns across engagements and help package them into repeatable offerings, accelerators, reference architectures, and pricing models
* Develop reusable estimation models, discovery frameworks, and PoC templates that raise the technical output of the broader team
* Help build and grow Apply Digital's internal Google Cloud community of practice

Technical Delivery \& Project Oversight


* Provide delivery leadership for the Google Cloud engagements you shape, ensuring they meet client requirements, quality standards, and business outcomes
* Guide technical teams through complex implementation challenges and ensure adherence to Google Cloud best practices

Team Leadership \& Development


* Mentor and coach junior and mid\-level architects on technical design, ecosystem navigation, and commercial pre\-sales discipline
* Support Google Cloud certification and delivery enablement across the technology team
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and retention of top Google Cloud talent
### **REQUIREMENTS**


* 10\+ years of experience in cloud architecture, enterprise solution architecture, or technical consulting in a professional services environment, with at least 2 years in a leadership role
* 3\+ years of dedicated experience in the Google Cloud ecosystem in a customer\- and partner\-facing capacity
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification
* Proven pre\-sales track record, including shaping complex technical deals, writing SOWs, and partnering with sales teams to hit revenue targets
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex solutions for large\-scale enterprise clients
* Experience working in digital agencies, strategic consultancies, or systems integrators delivering client\-facing solutions
* Deep, hands\-on expertise in modern cloud architectures, database systems (BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud Spanner), and containerization platforms (GKE, Cloud Run)
* Hands\-on production experience with modern AI stacks, such as Vertex AI, Gemini E

**Work at CBC/Radio\-Canada**


At CBC/Radio\-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  

  

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever\-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.


**Unposting Date:**

2026\-11\-27 11:59 PM
**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next\-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology \& Infrastructure (T\&I) team is the backbone and the future\-forward arm of CBC/Radio\-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

  



A place with purpose. CBC/Radio\-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in\-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**

  



**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End\-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio\-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

  



The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

  



Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio\-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T\&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

  



Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end\-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**


* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise\-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**


* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end\-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

  

**Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance**


* Oversee the governance function responsible for developing, maintaining and enforcing policies, standards, security architecture principles, exception management and industry frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, AI frameworks).
* Lead the third\-party and partner risk management program (covering vendors and technology contracts) in close collaboration with the Legal Services and Procurement teams.
* Co\-develop a governance, compliance and ethical framework for the enterprise\-wide use of AI and generative AI, assessing specific risks throughout their life cycle.
* Ensure strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., Quebec’s Law 25, GDPR and sector\-specific requirements).
* Drive a cybersecurity culture and awareness program focused on lasting behaviour change across the organization.

* Oversee the performance and modernization of the Security Operations Centre (SOC), advanced detection tools (SIEM, EDR/XDR, automation) and continuous threat monitoring.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Governance and Execution Oversight
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


The Senior Director, Governance \& Execution Oversight, Global Risk Intelligence and Technology (GRIT) is responsible for driving execution discipline, governance effectiveness, adoption management, and value realization across Global Risk transformation initiatives in AI, Data and Technology. The role serves as a key partner in Global Risk Technology and Intelligence governance, translating strategic priorities into executable workstreams while ensuring governance decisions result in measurable business outcomes.

  

  

This position will oversee intake and prioritization processes, establish operating frameworks and governance disciplines, and define the metrics and reporting needed to measure adoption, benefits realization, capacity utilization, and portfolio performance.

  

  

The role acts as a critical link between strategy, governance, execution, and sustained business value realization across the Global Risk portfolio.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


**Transformation Governance \& Strategic Execution**
----------------------------------------------------


* Partner with senior leaders to translate approved priorities into executable workstream plans.
* Establish and maintain governance processes supporting prioritization, intake, qualification, approval, and execution oversight.
* Drive accountability and follow\-through on decisions arising from governance forums.
* Coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment of delivery plans, dependencies, milestones, and outcomes.
* Monitor execution progress and escalate delivery risks, constraints, or resource challenges.

**Portfolio Management \& Prioritization**
------------------------------------------


* Support development and administration of portfolio intake, assessment, and prioritization frameworks.
* Evaluate transformation opportunities against strategic objectives, capacity constraints, risk considerations, and value criteria.
* Facilitate portfolio planning processes and support leadership decision\-making.
* Maintain visibility into transformation demand, delivery capacity, investment priorities, and execution status.
* Develop and implement portfolio reporting and performance management practices.

**Adoption \& Value Realization**
---------------------------------


* Define and implement measurement frameworks for technology, automation, AI, and Data transformation initiatives.
* Establish and report on key performance indicators measuring adoption, utilization, business outcomes, benefits realization, and operational effectiveness.
* Develop methodologies for measuring product value, customer value, business impact, and sustained adoption.
* Monitor trends and identify opportunities to improve user adoption and business outcomes.
* Partner with product owners, business stakeholders, and transformation leaders to address adoption barriers and optimize value realization.

**Operating Model \& Process Excellence**
-----------------------------------------


* Design and formalize governance operating models supporting transformation management and execution oversight.
* Develop and maintain RASCIs, Standard Operating Procedures, playbooks, operating frameworks, qualification frameworks, intake processes, and governance documentation.
* Establish repeatable and scalable operating practices across transformation portfolios.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve governance effectiveness and execution efficiency.

**Reporting, Insights \& Performance Management**
-------------------------------------------------


* Establish and execute recurring reporting cycles covering adoption performance, benefits realization, capacity utilization, portfolio performance, transformation progress, and product value realization.
* Develop dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting for executive audiences.
* Generate actionable insights supporting portfolio optimization and strategic decision\-making.
* Track and communicate transformation outcomes to senior leadership.

**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement**
---------------------------------------


* Build strong relationships with executives, product owners, transformation leads, and business stakeholders.
* Support leadership decision\-making through structured governance, analysis, and reporting.
* Facilitate alignment across teams involved in transformation delivery and adoption activities.
* Present recommendations, portfolio insights, and performance updates to leadership forums.
* Promote a culture of accountability, adoption, continuous improvement, and outcomes\-based delivery.
  

  

**Qualifications:**


**Education**
-------------


* University degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Information Technology, Organizational Change, or a related field.
* Professional certifications such as CPA, PMP, Agile, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, CBAP, or equivalent are considered an asset.

**Experience**
--------------


* 8\+ years of progressive experience supporting large\-scale business transformation, strategic execution, portfolio governance, program management, organizational effectiveness, or technology adoption initiatives.
* Experience working with executive governance forums and senior leadership teams.
* Experience developing performance reporting, operational metrics, dashboards, and value realization frameworks.
* Experience driving cross\-functional initiatives across complex organizations.
* Financial services, risk management, compliance, governance, or transformation office experience preferred.
  

  

***When you join our team:***


* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director, Financial Performance & Efficiency
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 279233
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

Scotiabank's Global Technology Enterprise Platforms (GTEP) provides secure, resilient and efficient technology infrastructure that enable the Bank's business strategy and customer experience. The Strategic Portfolio Office (SPO) supports GTEP leadership through integrated strategy, financial management, performance transparency, portfolio governance and enterprise\-wide transformation.

  

The **Director, Financial Performance \& Efficiency** is responsible for leading the financial performance management and efficiency agenda across GTEP. The role provides an integrated view of financial results, outlook, productivity and value delivery, enabling leaders to make timely, fact\-based decisions and deliver against financial commitments.

  

The role is accountable for strengthening planning, forecasting, performance reporting and cost governance; identifying and advancing sustainable efficiency opportunities; and translating financial and operational information into clear executive insights. This includes partnering across GTEP, Finance, Procurement and other stakeholders to improve transparency, accountability and execution.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Financial Planning \& Performance Management
	+ Lead integrated financial planning, forecasting and performance management across GTEP, aligning financial commitments with strategic priorities and delivery plans.
	+ Establish a clear and consistent view of actuals, outlook, variances, risks and opportunities, with defined ownership and actions to close performance gaps.
	+ Develop executive\-level reporting and insights that connect financial results with operational drivers, investment choices and business outcomes.
	+ Strengthen financial governance, management routines and decision support to improve predictability, transparency and accountability.

* Efficiency \& Value Optimization
	+ Define and advance the GTEP efficiency agenda, including sustainable cost reduction, demand management, productivity improvement and reinvestment opportunities.
	+ Identify, assess and prioritize efficiency opportunities using financial, operational and benchmark information; establish baselines, targets, benefits and delivery plans.
	+ Track realized and forecast benefits, challenge delivery gaps and ensure efficiency commitments are supported by credible actions and evidence.
	+ Promote disciplined cost management and value\-based decision making across the organization without compromising resilience, risk management or service outcomes.

* Governance, Reporting \& Insights
	+ Own the financial performance and efficiency reporting framework, including measures, definitions, data quality standards, controls and executive reporting cadence.
	+ Provide concise, forward\-looking insights and recommendations to GTEP leaders, highlighting material trends, trade\-offs, decisions and required interventions.
	+ Improve the consistency and usability of management information by simplifying reporting, reducing manual effort and enabling greater automation where appropriate.
	+ Support leadership forums, planning cycles and portfolio reviews with decision\-ready analysis and clear accountability for follow\-through.

* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
	+ Build trusted partnerships with GTEP leaders, Finance, Procurement, workforce teams, portfolio owners and other enterprise stakeholders.
	+ Influence senior stakeholders to align financial choices, operational priorities and efficiency actions with GTEP and Bank objectives.
	+ Foster a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, collaboration, continuous improvement and measurable value delivery.
	+ Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing team with strong capabilities in financial management, analytics, business advisory and executive communication.

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline; a professional accounting or finance designation is an asset.
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in financial management, business performance, strategic planning, cost optimization, technology finance or a related field within a large, complex organization.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise\-scale planning, forecasting, management reporting and efficiency programs.
* Strong financial acumen with the ability to connect financial results to operational drivers, strategic choices and measurable business outcomes.
* Advanced analytical and problem\-solving skills, with experience translating complex data into clear executive insights and recommendations.
* Experience establishing performance measures, financial governance, benefit tracking and management routines that improve accountability and execution.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and executive communication capabilities, including the ability to constructively challenge senior leaders.
* Demonstrated leadership experience building and developing high\-performing teams in a matrixed enterprise environment.
* Knowledge of technology infrastructure, enterprise platforms, financial services or regulated environments is an asset.

  

**What's in it for you?**

  

* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Allyship \- We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias\-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow \& participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability \& veterans.
* Acces

jobs.title: Director Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
**Division: Technology**

  

**Location: Toronto, Winnipeg**

  

  

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025\. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

  

Founded in 1926, IG Wealth Management is a key part of IGM's business model, providing comprehensive wealth management services to Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

  

With a vision to inspire financial confidence, IG Wealth Management is recognized as one of Manitoba’s Top Employers, Canada’s Top 100 Employers, and Best Diversity Employers, aiming to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

  

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

  

**Overall Job Purpose**


Accountable for enterprise strategy, standards, and guardrails across security platform and infrastructure engineering, with a direct mandate to mature Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as day to day operating capabilities. Shapes policy enforcement, resolves systemic constraints across multiple teams, and influences senior stakeholders on investment, resilience, and risk trade\-offs, translating enterprise considerations into actionable governance aligned to Technology standards.

  

**Key Accountabilities**


1\. Enterprise Strategy, Standards, and Guardrails


* Define and evolve enterprise platform and infrastructure standards spanning tooling, pipelines, shared services, automation, resilience, recoverability, and observability, and drive adoption across portfolios.
* Serve as trusted advisor on the highest\-complexity platform, infrastructure, and operational resilience issues across multiple teams.

2\. Threat Intelligence Enablement


* Own the enterprise standards for threat intelligence collection, enrichment, and dissemination so that intel drives compensating control recommendations for operators.
* Translate threat intelligence into prioritized, evidence\-based guardrails and detection requirements across the security ecosystem.

3\. DevSecOps and Secure Delivery


* Sponsor policy\-as\-code, automation, and knowledge automation practices so security controls are codified, machine\-testable, and enforced within pipelines.
* Define safe automation and CI/CD enablement patterns that embed security guardrails into build, test, deploy, and operate workflows.

4\. Systemic Constraint Resolution


* Resolve systemic platform and infrastructure constraints impacting delivery speed, reliability, security, capacity, stability, or recoverability across multiple teams.

5\. Resilience, Incident, and Operational Readiness


* Drive observability, resilience, and incident learning at enterprise scale, including telemetry, alerting, capacity, and DR readiness, to improve service maturity.

6\. Influence, Investment, and Escalation Governance


* Influence roadmap and investment decisions with evidence\-based trade\-offs on capability, risk, resilience, cost, and scalability.
* Determine when initiatives require escalation due to enterprise or regulatory impact and ensure consistent engagement with architecture and risk forums.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities and sequencing when constraints materially impact outcomes.

7\. AI\-Enabled Practices


* Shape and sponsor AI\-enabled platform and infrastructure strategy, including automation, predictive monitoring, and policy\-as\-code, aligned to security and governance.

8\. People and Capability Uplift


* Mentor senior ICs and strengthen capability uplift through communities of practice and standards forums.

9\. Continuous Improvement


* Identify recurring friction and enable durable fixes across the platform and infrastructure ecosystem.
  

**Qualifications**


* Post\-secondary education in Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Extensive progressive experience delivering enterprise platform and infrastructure services and enablement.
* Proven influence on standards, governance alignment, and risk\-informed decisions across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated leadership\-by\-influence with senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Deep expertise in automation, CI/CD enablement, observability, recoverability, and secure operations.
* Ability to shape AI\-enabled strategy and guardrails at scale.
* Demonstrated depth in Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as core operating disciplines.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is **$149,500 \- $192,500** which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short\-term incentive, health and well\-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.  

**Benefits:**

* **COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION \& RECOGNITION**: competitive base salary, performance\-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
* **EMPLOYEE BENEFITS \& INSURANCE:** competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short\-term \& long\-term disability plans.
* **RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS**: voluntary Defined Contribution Pension Plan
* **WORK LIFE BALANCE**: paid volunteer days, competitive time off, including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid \& flex work arrangements.

jobs.title: Director of Cloud & Kubernetes Platform
jobs.description:
McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care.


What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.


**Job Title: Director, Cloud \& Kubernetes Platform Engineering**


**Position Summary:**


We seek a visionary and technically accomplished Director of Cloud \& Kubernetes Platform Engineering to lead the design, development, and evolution of our cloud\-native platform capabilities. This strategic engineering leadership role is pivotal in building scalable, secure, and resilient cloud and container platforms while driving innovation in platform development across the organization.


The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in cloud platform engineering across Azure,GCP, and AWS andKubernetes ecosystem development, and multi\-cloud architectures, along with a proven track record of building and leading high\-performing platform engineering teams. Your engineering leadership will be instrumental in designing foundational platform capabilities, developer experiences, and self\-service infrastructure that accelerate the entire engineering organization.


**Job Responsibilities:**


**Platform Engineering Strategy**


* Define and execute a forward\-looking cloud and Kubernetes platform engineering strategy aligned with enterprise goals and digital transformation initiatives.
* Own P\&L responsibility, technology budget management, and ROI optimization for enterprise platform investments acrossAzure,GCP, and AWS.
* Develop and implement platform engineering roadmaps that align business goals with technical execution plans.
* Translate long\-term platform vision into prioritized, actionable engineering workstreams.
* Lead the development of strategic platform roadmaps to drive engineering velocity, scalability, and resilience.
**Multi\-Cloud Platform Development \& Architecture**


* Develop our next\-generation cloud\-native platforms spanningAzure,GCP,and AWSenabling scalable, portable workloads across a unified multi\-cloud estate.
* Design and implement cloud\-specific platform capabilities: AWS landing zones using Control Tower and Organizations; Azure platform engineering with Management Groups, Policy, and Blueprints; GCP platform design leveraging Organization Policies, Shared VPC, and Resource Hierarchy.
* Build and govern a consistent cloud abstraction layer that normalizes networking, IAM, secrets management, and compute across all threehyperscalers.
* Lead the engineering of cloud\-native managed Kubernetes services Amazon EKS, Azure AKS, and Google GKE into a cohesive, centrally governed multi\-cluster platform.
* Design and build internal developer platforms (IDPs) that deliver self\-service cloud provisioning, improving developer productivity and time\-to\-deploy across all cloud environments.
* Lead the engineering of Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) frameworks, CI/CD platform toolchains, and automation pipelines to support rapid, repeatable delivery across clouds.
* Drive platform reliability engineering through proactive design, SLO\-based engineering, error budgets, and scalable capacity planning.
* Establish and govern cloud platform standards, blueprints, and golden paths for engineering teams to build upon.
**Kubernetes \& Container Platform Engineering**


* Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of enterprise Kubernetes platforms across EKS, AKS, and GKE, including cluster architecture, networking, storage, and multi\-tenancy patterns.
* Engineer a unified multi\-cluster management plane enabling consistent deployment, policy enforcement, and observability across cloud providers.
* Build and mature container platform capabilities including image management, runtime security, policy enforcement, and workload scheduling.
* Drive adoption of service mesh, advanced networking, and observability tooling within the Kubernetes ecosystem.
* Partner with security teams to embed platform\-level security controls, pod security standards, and supply chain security practices.
**Cloud Networking \& Connectivity Engineering**


* Partner with the networking team on the design and engineeringcloud networking foundations including AWS Transit Gateway and VPC architecture, Azure Virtual WAN and Hub\-Spoke topologies, and GCP Shared VPC and Cloud Interconnect patterns.
* Support the networking team on the build and maintain private connectivity frameworkssuch asAWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, and GCP Dedicated Interconnect, ensuring high\-availability hybrid and multi\-cloud network paths.
* Partner with the networking team onengineering ofDNS, traffic management, and load balancing platforms across cloud providers to support global application delivery.
**Cloud Identity, Security \& Compliance Engineering**


* Engineer cloud identity and access management platforms across AWS IAM and SCPs, Azure Entra ID (Active Directory) and Conditional Access, and GCP IAM with Workload Identity Federation.
* Engineer cloud governance frameworks and embed compliance controls (e.g., HIPAA, SOC 2\) natively into the platform using AWS Config, Azure Policy, and GCP Organization Policies.
* Champion platform\-level security engineering practices across all cloud environments, including secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager), identity federation, and zero\-trust networking.
* Leveragecloud security posture management (CSPM) tooling and integrate findings into engineering workflows.
**Team Leadership**


* Inspire, mentor, and manage

jobs.title: Director, Newcomer Channel Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What’s the Opportunity?**


Newcomers are critical client segment for RBC, with distinct needs across their journey \- from preparing to move to Canada, to establishing their financial lives upon arrival, to building deeper financial relationships as they settle and grow.


As **Director, Newcomer Channel Strategy \& Operations**, you will lead the strategy and evolution of the channels, capabilities and partnership operations required to deliver a differentiated newcomer banking proposition. You will own the "how" behind our newcomer strategy: translating our ambition into intuitive client journeys, scalable capabilities, effective frontline experiences and an ecosystem of services that helps newcomers establish their lives in Canada.


This is a highly cross\-functional role. You will work across Everyday Banking \& Client Growth, Product, Digital, Enablement, Advice Centre, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and external partners to identify friction, establish priorities, and mobilize the organization around a multi\-year newcomer journey.

 **What You'll Do**

**Own the End\-To\-End Newcomer Onboarding Experience**

* Develop and continuously evolve the target experience for newcomers across key moments in their journey \- from pre\-arrival through onboarding, settlement, and early relationship growth
* Map and assess end\-to\-end newcomer journeys across digital, assisted, and non\-traditional channels
* Identify the highest impact experience gaps, friction points, and capability opportunities
* Define the target state newcomer experience and work cross\-functionally to define it into a prioritized roadmap
* Establish clear experience principles and standards that can be applied across products and channels
* Partner with Product and Journey teams to ensure newcomer needs are incorporated into broader enterprise roadmaps rather than addressed solely through segment\-specific initiatives

**Own the Pre\-Arrival Account Open Capability**

* Own and continuously evolve the end\-to\-end pre\-arrival account open capability, ensuring a seamless accessible and differentiated experience for newcomers establishing their relationship before coming to Canada
* Define the strategic direction and prioritized roadmap for pre\-arrival account opening, identifying opportunities to enhance functionality, simplify the client experience and expand acquisition opportunities
* Identify and address capability gaps, client friction points, and operational inefficiencies across the pre\-arrival account opening journey, from application and identity verification through account activation and funding
* Partner with Digital, Product, Technology, Business Development, Operations and Risk teams to deliver capability enhancements that balance client experience, business growth, operational scalability and regulatory requirements
* Identify opportunities to expand the reach and effectiveness of pre\-arrival account opening across priority newcomer markets, acquisition channels and strategic partnerships

**Enable Newcomer Onboarding, Policy \& Process**

* Lead the efforts to remove unnecessary complexity from how newcomers establish a banking relationship while ensuring appropriate risk and regulatory requirements are maintained
* Identify policies or processes creating disproportionate friction for newcomers
* Clarify documentation, identification, residency and eligibility requirements
* Challenge legacy processes and distinguish true regulatory requirements from internal practices
* Design scalable solutions that balance client experience, growth, operational simplicity and risk
* Improve consistency in how newcomer policies are understood and executed across channels **Own the Newcomer Channel Strategy**
* Define how newcomer clients should be served across digital, branch, AC, and non\-traditional channels (i.e. referral partnerships), including the role each channel plays throughout the journey.
* Identify capabilities required to increase digital self\-service while preserving high\-value human advice
* Partner with digital and journey teams to influence enterprise capability roadmaps
* Work with distribution leaders to understand frontline friction and execution gaps
* Ensure new capabilities and propositions can be delivered consistently across channels

jobs.title: Director, Finance, HR and Operations
jobs.description:
**Brion Raffoul** is a leading IP boutique law firm in Canada, situated in Westboro, Ottawa. Our exceptional team is passionate about helping innovative companies protect their ideas, designs and brands worldwide. Our clients include domestic and multinational companies, government agencies, as well as universities.

We are seeking a **Director, Finance, HR and Operations** to join our operations on a full\-time basis. Reporting directly to the Managing Partner, the Director will be responsible for managing the full scope of the company’s financials, including the day\-to\-day accounting operations, and for leading the firm’s human resources and day\-to\-day operations. The ideal candidate will bring a positive, hands\-on approach and must be comfortable with problem\-solving and managing multiple priorities at once, holding staff accountable and following tasks through to completion without reminders. This is a terrific opportunity to take full ownership of a senior role while working directly with the Managing Partner to help shape the future of the business.

As a member of the management team, the Director will contribute to strategic planning, ensure compliance with legislative requirements, and provide leadership to staff, the Managing Partner and Management Team. The role also supervises and mentors a team of 20 to support daily operations. The Director is the first point of contact for all staff matters and manages people directly: setting clear expectations, giving timely feedback, and addressing performance and policy issues.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Human Resources \& People Management*

* Lead all HR operations for the firm’s staff, including recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management and departures.
* Own the full employee life cycle: a written training plan in place before each new hire’s first day; 30, 60 and 90\-day check\-ins; and structured departures (notices, systems access, equipment, firm announcements).
* Hold staff accountable: set clear expectations, deliver regular substantive feedback, and address performance and policy issues (including attendance and work\-from\-home policies) directly and promptly.
* Plan and maintain a firm\-wide training calendar and track completion.
* Review timesheets, expense claims and other staff submissions for completeness and accuracy before they reach the partners.
* Oversee payroll, benefits, group health insurance and RRSP programs, employment contracts and employee records.
* Onboard contractors and outsourced staff, confirming equipment, systems access, confidentiality agreements and schedules in writing before the start date.
* Maintain HR policies and the employee handbook, and advise leadership on employment standards, health and safety, human rights and other legislative compliance.
* Promote a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace culture.

*Financial Management \& Accounting*

* Lead all financial operations, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and compliance with GAAP.
* Oversee accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and general ledger functions.
* Prepare, and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports.
* Review all reports and calculations for accuracy and completeness before distribution.
* Work with the IP Manager and administrative staff so work is invoiced at a regular cadence through the month, avoiding month\-end backlogs.
* Manage cash flow, banking relationships, and investments.
* Coordinate the annual audit and liaise with auditors and the Financial Institutions.
* Complete all statutory filings, including CRA returns, HST, EHT and payroll remittances.
* Maintain and strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and procedures.

*Budgeting \& Financial Planning*

* Lead the annual budgeting process with the Managing Partner.
* Provide forecasts, variance analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision\-making.
* Plan and lead finance system changes, such as an accounting software migration, with a written project plan, timeline and staff training.

*Administrative Leadership \& Supervision*

* Supervise and mentor staff members: Administrative \& Accounting Support and Reception \& Office Support
* Provide coaching and professional development to enhance team skills and performance.
* Ensure effective daily operations, workflow coordination, and clear communication across the administrative team.
* Oversee reception and office upkeep (supplies, cleaning, deliveries) with regular checks, so issues are caught and resolved without partner involvement.
* Improve administrative processes, systems, and tools for operational efficiency.

*Facilities \& Operations Management*

* Oversee building operations and maintenance, working with contractors and suppliers, and following up on repairs through to completion.
* Manage service agreements for Security, HVAC, and other ad hoc maintenance contracts.
* Lead risk management and insurance review processes.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and workplace health and safety standards.
* Develop and implement facilities and operational continuity policies.

*Information Technology \& Systems*

* Oversee IT systems, data security, and technology operations with support from external IT consultant
* Plan and manage technology upgrades and infrastructure improvements as required
* Support digital transformation efforts to enhance efficiency and data integrity.
* Use AI and automation tools to streamline reporting and administrative work.
* Manage the annual IT budget.

*Organizational Support \& Collaboration*

* Participate in organizational strategy, planning, and reporting as part of the management team.
* Provide financial and administrative guidance to the Executive Team.
* Support communications and marketing initiatives.
* Foster collaboration and effective communication across all departments.
* Represent the organization in external meetings as required.

jobs.title: Director, Total Compensation and HR Data
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

VOSKER is a North American leader in remote area surveillance.


Every day, we’re proud to help our customers keep an eye on what truly matters to them by developing solar\-powered, cellular\-connected cameras integrated with our exclusive platform.


In a few words, at VOSKER: we perform, we think differently, and we take care of our people. We leverage our expertise to win as a team and redefine what’s possible!


WHAT WE OFFER

* A work environment where your ideas come to life and your ambitions take flight
* A dynamic, non\-routine daily life every day is different, and that’s what makes it exciting!
* A hybrid work model: work from home or from one of our offices it’s your choice
* The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for up to 3 months (90 days)
* Access to a learning platform to grow your skills on company time
* A wellness account to reimburse expenses related to your health, passions, and interests
* Free 24/7 access to online healthcare professionals and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Comprehensive group insurance including vision and dental, 50% paid by the employer
* A group RRSP with employer contributions
* Parental leave top\-up for new parents
* Vacation based on your total years of professional experience

  

**Job Description**  

Fair compensation, benefits that make a difference in our people’s lives, and data that informs decisions: at VOSKER, you’ll have the chance to shape all of this.


As the head of total compensation and reporting to the Head of Culture and Organizational Performance, you’ll be a trusted partner in a role that’s both strategic and highly hands\-on. If you enjoy influencing decisions without losing sight of the big picture, this position is for you.

  

WHAT’S IN STORE FOR YOU:

* Compensation: Define and implement VOSKER’s compensation policies in the context of growth and the integration of current (Estonia or Germany) or future acquisitions.
* Business Partnership: Support the teams’ needs regarding salary recommendations, salary benchmarking, annual raises, bonus plans and long\-term incentive programs, pay equity, and business intelligence.
* Employee Benefits and Savings: Develop our programs, negotiate contracts, and manage external partners (Dialogue, Industrielle Alliance, Solertia, etc.) .
* Data and HRIS: Analyze and share key metrics with the Talent \& Culture team and senior management. Support the systems administration team in governing T\&C data via the HRIS (UKG Pro) and oversee the deployment of new HRIS modules as needed.
* Mergers and Acquisitions: Participate in due diligence and the integration of upcoming projects.
* Budget: Participate in establishing annual payroll and benefits budgets with the Finance team.
* Promoting the Value Proposition: Collaborate with colleagues in the Culture Promotion team to foster transparency and highlight the value proposition to employees.
* Leadership and Strategic Oversight: Motivate and guide the total compensation team and its members, while staying abreast of emerging market trends and compensation governance practices.

 **Qualifications** **Key Qualifications**

* You hold a bachelor’s degree in human resources management, finance, actuarial science, or any other relevant field.
* You have held a strategic position in compensation management for at least 7 years, with solid knowledge of employee benefits, long\-term incentive plans, and retirement savings.
* You are comfortable taking on a cross\-functional role that involves frequent and complex collaboration with various departments.
* You have a strong ability to influence both senior management and the entire workforce, and you can communicate the company’s compensation vision in both French and English (written and oral).
* You want to play a strategic role while remaining firmly grounded in hands\-on work and execution.

**Plus Points**

* You have experience in an international environment and in integrating new entities following acquisitions (strongly preferred).
* You are committed to delivering a distinctive employee experience and find creative solutions to the situations that arise.
* You have a good sense of humor and the desire to take on this very serious role without taking yourself too seriously!

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A high\-impact role in a fast\-growing company, at the heart of integrating new teams across Europe.
* An international setting and a variety of challenges: compensation, benefits, data, and onboarding.
* A culture where we take our work seriously, but not ourselves.
* A hybrid work model that involves working in downtown Montreal at least once a week, occasionally in Victoriaville, and from home on other days.

  

**Additional Information** **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**


At VOSKER, we value the uniqueness of every individual and celebrate the diversity that helps us redefine what’s possible. We foster collaboration in a healthy, inclusive work environment where all voices are heard.


If you have specific needs to make the recruitment process more accessible, don’t hesitate to reach out.


Now it’s your turn, tell us about yourself and apply today

**Work at CBC/Radio\-Canada**


At CBC/Radio\-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  

  

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever\-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next\-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology \& Infrastructure (T\&I) team is the backbone and the future\-forward arm of CBC/Radio\-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

  



A place with purpose. CBC/Radio\-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in\-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**

  



**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End\-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio\-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

  



The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

  



Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio\-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T\&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

  



Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end\-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

  



**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**


* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise\-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**


* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end\-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

  

**Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance**


* Oversee the governance function responsible for developing, maintaining and enforcing policies, standards, security architecture principles, exception management and industry frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, AI frameworks).
* Lead the third\-party and partner risk management program (covering vendors and technology contracts) in close collaboration with the Legal Services and Procurement teams.
* Co\-develop a governance, compliance and ethical framework for the enterprise\-wide use of AI and generative AI, assessing specific risks throughout their life cycle.
* Ensure strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., Quebec’s Law 25, GDPR and sector\-specific requirements).
* Drive a cybersecurity culture and awareness program focused on lasting behaviour change across the organization.
